name: cafe
label: Cafe
css: .style-cafe { --slide-primary: #5D4432; --slide-secondary: #E9E3DD; --slide-surface: #F9F7F5; --slide-text: #3E2B1E; background: var(--slide-surface); color: var(--slide-text); font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 48px; min-height: 100%; } .style-cafe::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -40%; width: 60%; height: 60%; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary), transparent); opacity: 0.06; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-cafe .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .style-cafe .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text); margin: 24px 0 0 0; z-index: 1; max-width: 95%; } .style-cafe .step { position: absolute; top: 48px; right: 48px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-cafe .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 48px; left: 48px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary); letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-cafe { --slide-primary: #E9E3DD; --slide-secondary: #5D4432; --slide-surface: #2D1F15; --slide-text: #F9F7F5; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2D1F15 0%, #3E2B1E 100%); } .slide-code.style-cafe .hook { color: #F9F7F5; } .slide-code.style-cafe .text { color: #E9E3DD; } .slide-code.style-cafe .step { color: #F9F7F5; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-cafe .brand { color: #E9E3DD; } .slide-code.style-cafe::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, #E9E3DD, transparent); opacity: 0.04; } .slide-insight.style-cafe { --slide-primary: #E9E3DD; --slide-secondary: #5D4432; --slide-surface: #1A1410; --slide-text: #F9F7F5; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1A1410 0%, #2D1F15 100%); } .slide-insight.style-cafe .hook { color: #F9F7F5; } .slide-insight.style-cafe .text { color: #E9E3DD; } .slide-insight.style-cafe .step { color: #F9F7F5; opacity: 0.1; } .slide-insight.style-cafe .brand { color: #E9E3DD; } .slide-insight.style-cafe::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, #E9E3DD, transparent); opacity: 0.05; } .slide-insight.style-cafe .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: #F9F7F5; line-height: 1.4; margin: 32px 0; max-width: 90%; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
